title: We Closed Our Series A-3 Funding
body_markdown:
As a tech-driven team initiating **the world’s first intelligent NFT** and creating **the world’s first** **AAA play-to-earn game** , **** we are thrilled to announce that **rct AI has successfully raised over $10 Million in the Series A-3 funding** from top investors in gaming, AI and blockchain based in the US, China, Japan and other countries & regions in the world.


Great appreciation for the trust, understanding, and companionship of our existing investors: SkySaga Capital, Y Combinator, Makers Fund, and Galaxy Interactive. Thanks to their active support, rct AI has built deep partnerships with 10+ game companies worldwide and served over 200 million users so far.


Driven by **Deterrence** , **** the world’s first **AI Layer** for powering intelligent NFTs created by rct AI, we have integrated cutting-edge technologies such as **AI-to-earn(AI yield farming)** , **AI conversation models** , **AI intent recognition** and **AI motion generation** to create cognitively aware virtual beings that are massively distributed to every corner of the crypto world.


Every AI-powered intelligent NPC and virtual being can sense state changes in digital environments, so that player interactions are **not limited to fixed and repetitive dialogues and choices** .


Meanwhile, these crypto-native characters are also able to join **automated yield framing** in different gamefi projects on blockchains, offering **higher liquidity** to gamefi NFT assets and delivering **higher revenue** for players who hold them.


We have implemented these unique capabilities into **Deterrence** and deliver them to all play-to-earn games connected to the ecosystem.


And more importantly, **Deterrence** supports AI yield farming not only **in our own games** , but also **in other play-to-earn games on different blockchains** with automated revenue acquisition — constructing multiple sustainable Metaverse in different economic systems.


Several of our in-house developed games have already been connected to this blockchain ecosystem, including **the world’s first** **AAA play-to-earn game** and **** a series of **boutique play-to-earn games** using intelligent NFTs to connect various notable communities, projects and dapps.


Besides this, we are actively collaborating with other play-to-earn games based on different blockchains. And soon, these revolutionary crypto games will be released one after another and lead the whole gamefi ecosystem into the next generation.


On May 23, 2021, **the world’s first intelligent NFT** co-created by rct AI and renowned crypto artist Ting Song, named Nüwa, received continuous widespread attention and became the top-priced work of the Yongle auction.


This product also represents the release of the world’s first intelligent NFT Chip, **** a standardized product powered by **Deterrence** for all creators and teams to build high-quality and life-like intelligent virtual beings and creatures of all types.


After that, rct AI has launched the world’s first intelligent NFT collection, Mirror NFT. It marks the beginning of our own boutique gamefi project Mirror World, achieving multiple series of partnerships with various notable projects and communities.


Up to now, the Mirror NFTs have interacted with their holders for millions of times.


For Details:


[Website](https://mirrorworld.fun/) |[Discord](https://discord.gg/XCZAsfu2zC) |[Twitter](https://twitter.com/joinmirrorworld) |[Opensea](https://opensea.io/collection/mirrorworld)


Now, we’re excited to announce that rct AI has closed its Series A-3 funding with new partners joining us as well as additional investment from our existing partner Galaxy Interactive!


Funding from Series A-3 has been raised from some of the most influential players globally, namely Yuanyuzhou Ventures, Springwind Ventures, Galaxy Interactive, Bonfire Union, Everest Ventures Group, FBG Capital, Folius Ventures, HashKey Capital, Hash Global, Mr. Liang Xinjun (Co-founder of Fosun Group), Lucid Blue Ventures, Mask Network, PKSHA SPARX Algorithm Fund, SNZ, and Zonff Partners.


All investors are very active within gaming, AI and blockchain industries.


What lies ahead of us is an unprecedented endeavor in human history.


As we live together with truly intelligent virtual beings and intelligent NFTs to move forward and develop the vast and multitudinous Metaverse, we are also refreshing our understanding and knowledge of life itself.


We would like to express our most sincere appreciation to all our partners who recognize, trust, and support rct AI, and strive to fulfill their expectations.


Thank you all!
